div.div: Forge — Compiler Pipeline
From file copier to context compiler. Four new stages, zero breaking changes.

switch.text: From file copier to context compiler. Four new stages, zero breaking changes.

div.div: CURRENT (v0.6)

Source.load()
Git / Local / Smithery

Filter
include / exclude / map

Resolve Targets
layout detection + transforms

Build Plan
diff, conflicts, mutations

Write Files
apply mutations + sync state
COMPILER (v0.8+) — four new stages inserted between Filter and Resolve

switch.text: COMPILER (v0.8+) — four new stages inserted between Filter and Resolve

div.div: PARSE

v0.8 — Frontmatter Parser
Extract YAML metadata from skills:
name, depends, tags, context,
priority, budget.
SourceFile[] → SkillNode[]
ANALYZE

v0.9 — Skill Graph
Build DAG from depends fields.
Topo sort, cycle detection.
v0.10 — Project Context
Detect languages/frameworks
from marker files (pom.xml, etc.)
OPTIMIZE

v0.10 — Tree-Shaking
Remove skills irrelevant to project.
Dependency-pull protection.
v0.11 — Token Budgeting
Enforce per-agent limits.
Priority-ordered dropping.
EMIT

v0.12 — Per-Agent Emitters
Optimized output per assistant.
CC: priority-prefixed files.
Cursor: merged .mdc rules.
v0.13 — Manifest
Structured build output → Ember
